title: Contextual column prioritization and density toggle for virtual table
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Our virtualized table component currently relies on static column priority rules and a single global density setting. For high-cardinality tables and heterogeneous row content (metadata rows, wide free-text cells, badges), the current behavior leads to poor information discoverability: important columns get collapsed, wide content is clipped unexpectedly, and switching density requires trial-and-error.

Goal: Design a context-aware column prioritization system and a user-friendly density toggle that: 1) prioritizes columns based on configurable 'column weight' and runtime content sampling, 2) exposes a lightweight density preview and per-view presets, and 3) integrates with the virtualized rendering model without harming scroll performance or keyboard navigation.

Proposed solution overview:
- Column weight model: introduce a numeric "weight" token on column configs (0-100) that augments developer-provided priorities. Weights can be set by column type (identifier, timestamp, title, free-text), with sensible defaults in the design system tokens.
- Content-aware sampler: during initial render and idle periods we sample visible cell widths for the first N rows (configurable) to estimate natural column widths. Sampling runs in a low-priority web worker and updates the weight-adjusted layout heuristics.
- Hybrid collapse strategy: instead of only collapsing low-priority columns, introduce an "elastic collapse" where non-essential columns enter a compact badge or tooltip state at narrow widths; essential columns remain but can be compacted (e.g., icon-only) using design token sets.
- Density toggle with scrubber preview: a compact control in the table toolbar that shows four density presets (Comfortable, Default, Compact, Ultra-Compact). Hovering or scrubbing the control previews density changes on the visible rows only (CSS variable swap) and includes live token delta info (row-height, gutter, font-size).
- Per-view presets: users can save density + column weight overrides to local storage and, if logged in, persist to account settings (small API contract exists already with the console team). Presets surface in the toolbar dropdown.
- Keyboard-first collapse: collapse/expand hotkeys (and roving focus semantics) so keyboard users can toggle compact states per-column; focus indicators use updated tokens to maintain contrast.
- Accessibility: Ensure that column collapse states are announced via aria-expanded and provide a "show hidden columns" button that opens a keyboard-navigable menu. Density preview must not trap focus; it should be ephemeral and screenreader-friendly.

Design token implications:
- Add token group table.columnWeight.{type} with values for title, id, metric, timestamp, tag.
- Add density tokens: spacing.rowHeight.{comfortable,default,compact,ultra}, spacing.cellGutter.{...}, type.scale adjustments for compact modes.
- Update focus ring and hit target tokens for compact modes to preserve WCAG 2.1 AA.

Deliverables:
- High-fidelity mocks of toolbar density scrubber and presets (desktop + responsive mobile collapsed toolbar)
- Interaction prototypes showing sampler-driven layout changes and keyboard interactions (Figma + Loom walkthrough)
- Token spec PR for spacing and column weight suggestions
- Developer acceptance criteria and sample usage patterns for eng (API examples, opt-in flag for sampling)

Trade-offs and constraints:
- Sampling frequency must be throttled to avoid CPU/GPU spikes; we prioritize web worker based sampling and debounce updates to layout.
- Persisted presets introduce sync complexity across devices; default to last-saved-device for MVP and add server sync later.
- Edge cases: extraordinarily wide cells (images, long code blocks) will be clipped by default; we will include an optional overflow preview affordance in a follow-up.

Dependencies and stakeholders:
- Engineering: runtime/virtualization team (ENG-20410) for sampling hook and opt-in flag; frontend infra for worker API
- Product: PM lead Miguel Rivera for prioritization and telemetry OKR alignment
- Console team: settings persistence API and auth contract
- Accessibility review scheduled with Security & Accessibility team

Acceptance criteria (short):
- Design tokens and Figma specs merged into design system library
- Prototype demonstrates <100ms freeze for a 20k-row table when sampling toggled on at start (perf goals for engineering validation)
- Toolbar allows previewing density presets without full rerender
- Keyboard flow exists for toggling column collapse and restoring hidden columns

2025-11-12 - Accessibility review (Ana Sato): Request to ensure aria-live region for sampler updates and explicit labels for the density presets. We should avoid motion for the scrubber when reduced-motion is enabled.

2025-11-15 - Engineering sync (Samuel Cho): Eng will implement a lightweight sampling worker. We flagged potential performance regressions with long CSS custom property swaps; clustered updates recommended.
